role: Real structural completeness check for academic/non-fiction documents — required sections present, real abstract word-count range (100-150), same pattern as E-22's title-length check.
behaviorDescription: reviewDocument() checks a real document against six required sections and a real abstract word-count range, verified against a complete doc, a doc missing sections, and an out-of-range abstract before implementation.
hardStops: Never marks a document complete when a real required section is genuinely empty
Never fabricates a word count not derived from the real abstract text
